value.rationale: A naturally distinguished first nontrivial prime-adic shell of the long-studied A080170 binomial gcd receives a complete exact gcd classification. Distinct from the published support criterion, the single-carry witness proves nontrivial sharpness for all eligible p,a,m; the invariant controls exact multiplicity, not merely support.
